title: U.S. Southwest semiconductor workforce and supplier scaling evidence
question: Can local supplier and workforce systems support semiconductor scaling?
why_it_matters: Funded semiconductor projects only become operating capacity if labor pipelines, construction capacity, suppliers, training systems, and capital commitments can keep up.
current_support: FTFN has national CHIPS program context, a hardened local system profile, and a selected MAG regional projections dataset for population, housing, and employment context. It still lacks workforce-pipeline, training-capacity, construction-labor, and supplier-network records.
candidate_records: MAG 2023 population, housing, and employment projections
next_action: Pair the MAG projections layer with official workforce, training, supplier, construction labor, and economic-development records before making chip-corridor capacity claims.
notes: Phase 50 added a named regional planning dataset, but the gap remains open because manufacturing scale depends on people and suppliers as much as funding or regional growth context.
